name: Firehose
description: Firehose monitors the web in real time: write rules and get every newly crawled page that matches, or watch specific URLs for changes.

events.d: Create a new tap and get its token to add rules and receive matches.
List all taps in your organization or get one tap by ID.
Rename a tap or pause and resume its matching.
Permanently delete a tap, revoking its token and removing its rules.
Start watching a web page for changes on a chosen schedule.
List your watched URLs or get one watch with its change history.
Change how often a watched URL is checked, or pause and resume it.
Stop watching a URL and delete its watch.
Add a rule (search query) to the tap so matching web pages are delivered.
List all rules on the tap or get one rule by ID.
Change a rule query, tag or filters on the tap.
Permanently delete a rule from the tap.
Check a rule query for errors before saving it.
Runs when a newly crawled web page matches a rule on the tap, optionally for chosen rules.

recipes.ae: List a record by Record ID
